notes: A new Projects page lists everything you've saved, with search, sorting, rename, duplicate and delete with undo. Sort projects into groups and star the ones you use most. The home screen shows the four you opened last, and Tangent starts faster with many projects.
notes_zh_tw: 新增「專案」頁，列出所有儲存過的專案，可搜尋、排序、重新命名、建立副本，刪除後可以復原。可以把專案分到群組、加上星號。首頁只顯示最近開啟的四個專案，專案很多時啟動也更快。
